findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: validate_peru_ruc, validate_mexico_rfc, validate_colombia_nit, validate_costa_rica_cedula, validate_tax_id_format, validate_tax_id · Private data: validate_peru_ruc · Public sink: validate_tax_id · Destructive: validate_peru_ruc, validate_tax_id_format, validate_tax_id.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: validate_peru_ruc, validate_mexico_rfc, validate_colombia_nit, validate_costa_rica_cedula, validate_tax_id_format, validate_tax_id · Private data: validate_peru_ruc · Public sink: validate_tax_id · Destructive: validate_peru_ruc, validate_tax_id_format, validate_tax_id

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
